comparator.route: Bachelor of Arts with an interdomain Humanities and Social Sciences major
comparator.sourceNotes: The 2026–2027 regulations set a 180 EC degree with at least 45 EC at level 3. This example shows a Humanities and Social Sciences interdomain BA. It allocates the 75 EC major minimum, including the 15 EC thesis, and shows both domains’ methods separately. The remaining choice space can change if approved methods overlap or the student takes more major courses.

comparatorRouteSelection.route: Bachelor of Arts with an interdomain Humanities and Social Sciences major
comparatorRouteSelection.basis: The generic UCU target does not specify BA/BSc, domain or discipline. The formally available Humanities-and-Social-Sciences interdomain BA major most directly represents UCU's broad interdisciplinary academic identity and the programme overview's cross-disciplinary social and cultural examples. Exact tracks remain student choices; the route was selected before and independently of UCR course selection.

alternativeSelection.assessment: Two coherent generator-backed directions beyond the broad closest match are feasible and substantively distinct: society, power and culture; and life, mind and health. Both materially change the curriculum and exceed the pairwise 30-EC floor. The maximum of three alternatives is therefore reached; environment and sustainability, economics and social analysis, and mathematics and physical science remain coherent assessed directions but cannot be added.

comparisonAlignment.rationale: Both first-year courses develop research questions, evidence evaluation and written argument. UCR also emphasises personal and professional development.
UCR covers interviews, observation and qualitative analysis, which overlap with UCU’s qualitative option. UCU also allows other methods depending on the thesis discipline.
Both introduce empirical research design and statistical analysis. UCU teaches them in a social-science context.
Explicitly unmatched after semantic review: no scheduled UCR course was judged a sufficiently direct counterpart to Introduction to Rhetoric and Informal Logic.
Explicitly unmatched after semantic review: no scheduled UCR course was judged a sufficiently direct counterpart to Humanities methods at level 2.
UCU requires a 15 EC thesis within the major. The optional 15 EC UCR research element sits outside the course schedules.

comparator.text: Humanities and Social Sciences major coursework
comparator.note: Complete tracks in at least two disciplines. The two advanced track finishers and the separately listed thesis account for at least 30 EC of level 3 work in the major.
Complete a qualifying course by the end of semester four.

comparator.text: Further course choices, including Science breadth
comparator.note: Take a Science course in the first year as part of the breadth requirement. The remaining credits allow further major study, electives or other approved choices.

notes.text: Both colleges offer interdisciplinary Liberal Arts and Sciences. The UCU example shows an interdomain BA with disciplinary tracks, methods in both domains, and a required thesis. The UCR columns show three course schedules. At UCR, a cluster-specific major depends on the courses completed.

audience.programmeDescription: University College Utrecht offers a Liberal Arts and Sciences degree across Humanities, Science and Social Sciences. This example shows a BA major combining Humanities and Social Sciences.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The UCR examples combine society, culture and science, focus on power and institutions, or explore life science, cognition and health.

curriculum.routeLabel: Interdomain Humanities and Social Sciences BA

cellNotes.text: Both first-year courses develop research questions, evidence evaluation and written argument. UCR also emphasises personal and professional development.
UCR covers interviews, observation and qualitative analysis, which overlap with UCU’s qualitative option. UCU also allows other methods depending on the thesis discipline.
Both introduce empirical research design and statistical analysis. UCU teaches them in a social-science context.
UCU requires a 15 EC thesis within the major. The optional 15 EC UCR research element sits outside the course schedules.
This row groups the major coursework. Students complete tracks in at least two disciplines.
UCU requires a qualifying Language and Culture course by the end of semester four.
These credits include the first-year Science breadth course in this example.
